children: Industrial production in Slovakia grew by 2.4% year-on-year in July 2026, accelerating from a 2.1% rise in June and marking the third increase this year.
The growth was supported by higher output in 10 of the 15 monitored industrial sectors, led by the manufacture of motor vehicles, which surged 9.2% and recorded its strongest growth so far this year.
Its result was partly boosted by a calendar shift in the annual plant-wide holiday at a key manufacturer, which operated for an additional week in July compared with a year earlier.
Output also increased sharply in the manufacture of machinery and equipment (11.9%) and basic metals (5.5%).
By contrast, production of computer, electronic and optical products plunged 41%, while coke and refined petroleum products fell 17.8%.
On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial production decreased 0.7%, the same pace as in the preceding period.
In the first seven months of 2026, industrial activity declined 0.4% year-on-year.

title: Slovakia Industrial Output Growth Accelerates in July
